messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for eu-west model-v2 -> 10% is reporting elevated tail latency and 502 errors on /v1/embed. metrics: https://grafana.internal/r/embeds?panel=tail && alert: CANARY_EMBED_502_EUW :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Paging on-call for eng-oncall (severity: high). PagerDuty incident #INC12345 created and notified.

jess (oncall): seeing it. pulling logs now. can someone confirm if this is latency or errored decode?

mike: 502s, stack shows kernel eviction on quant path, repeated OOMs on a subset of pods. first spike at 15:07 UTC.

sara: on it - checking container logs + host dmesg. suspect quantized kernel mismatch after last runtime change.

anil: stopping canary traffic now. flipping traffic rule to route to stable model-v1 in eu-west. command: `curl -XPOST https://router.internal/api/redirect -d '{"route":"/embed","from":"model-v2","to":"model-v1","percent":100}'`

jess (oncall): good. also start the kill-switch for feature flag model-v2 rollout. product-ops can you confirm flag id?

product-ops: flag id = model-variant-eu-v2. executing kill switch: ```
/ops feature_flags toggle --env prod --flag model-variant-eu-v2 --state off
```

leo: confirm kill switch applied (ui shows OFF). traffic is swinging back to v1. grafana shows 502s dropping within one minute.

mike: still seeing a few degraded pods with high OOM churn. adding node drain + restart for those hosts: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeds-eu --namespace inference`

jess (oncall): good. estimate customer impact? product-ops, any reports?

product-ops: initial sampling indicates ~3.8% of EU embed requests failed with 502 during 15:07-15:12 UTC. Two paying customers (acme-corp, beta-chat) observed retries and degraded quality but no data leakage. notifying account teams.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2 due to partial region impact and customer-visible errors. Handoff window starting in 20 minutes.

anil: collecting core dumps and perf traces from the failing pods. saving to s3://redwood-incident/1739504321/ for postmortem.

sara: quick mitigation checklist: 1) kill-switch flag off (done), 2) route traffic back to v1 (done), 3) restart degraded pods (in progress), 4) enable extra autoscale buffer (done +20% capacity in eu-west).

mike: rolling back runtime change commit `ab12c4` that introduced quant kernel reorder on eu nodes. will push a canary of the rollback to staging and then to eu after verification.

jess (oncall): good. current status: user-facing errors mostly recovered, tail latency back to baseline, kill switch and rollback procedures in motion. action owners: anil (for traces/postmortem), mike (rollout/rollback), sara (pod remediation), product-ops (customer comms).

product-ops: opening a support thread to notified customers, drafting a short status update. will coordinate final messaging after postmortem details.

leo: leaving a note for next oncall: if errors reappear, escalate to eng-runtime and consider full regional capacity freeze.

jess (oncall): handing off to mike for the night shift. summary: canary caused kernel mismatch -> kill switch applied -> traffic back to v1 -> ongoing pod restarts + rollback. severity SEV2 -> monitor for 1h then de-escalate if stable.

mike: taking over. I'll post an interim update at +30m and attach traces. tagging @eng-runtime for follow-up tomorrow.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded. New on-call: mike. Next update due 15:45 UTC.

sara: attaching quick diagnostic snippets in thread: ```
# sample failing log
2024-06-08T15:07:12Z embed-service ERROR kv_cache_pop: kernel: quant_reorder failed: OOM
# restart command
kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeds-eu --namespace inference
```

anil: note for postmortem: verify kernel selection logic when sequence lengths >> 1024 and quantized weights. looks like an edge-case in kernel picker.

product-ops: cc ops contacts for acme-corp and beta-chat. sending initial status now.

mike: +1. monitoring dashboards: errors -> 0.4% now, baseline 0.1%. keeping this open until 16:15 UTC.

jess (oncall): thanks team. leaving notes in incident tracker INC12345. updating runbook links: https://confluence.internal/infra/runbooks/canary-failure

deploy-bot: Canary stopped, stable traffic resumed.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 updated: status=stabilized, severity=SEV2, owners=[anil,mike,sara,product-ops].

mike: I'm on it for the next hour. will start full rollback to previous runtime tomorrow morning if traces confirm kernel-picker regression.

jess (oncall): handing off closed. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
